^GSPC.src: FMP index history pulled inside Fly (daily-bars-rsi/fmp-indexes.json · ^GSPC)

^NDX.src: FMP index history pulled inside Fly (daily-bars-rsi/fmp-indexes.json · ^NDX)

LEADERS.src: equal-weight basket of each year's top-20 S&P names by market cap on 1 Jan (FMP caps, leaders lane), members rebalanced each calendar year; closes from the chart API cache

live.source: chart API /quote and /macro (VIX) read live during the session; not a close

breadth.hubSnapshot: data/breadth/latest.json is the Hub's own 23 Sep reading (36.8% above the 50-day of 364 names); the B1 whole-market table (breadth_daily) is on a candidate branch, not on live, so it is not read here

pcc.note: Cboe prints one total put/call per session after the close; today's is not known until tonight

today.source: the live detector's store as Alan read it at ~13:30 ET (public.scintillas); the session is not over

leaders.name: Leaders basket (each year's top 20 at the time, equal weight)

analogs.note: distance = root-mean-square of percentile differences across the gauges both days carry (at least five); picks at least 40 sessions apart; nothing from the last 60 sessions

wing.replayNote: the sector-rotation lane checked this replay against the live /geiger rung by rung (largest difference 0); the same lib.mjs is used here

components: equal ÷ cap weight, 63-session change (inverted: low = narrow)

seven.cited: statistician-2 q7.seven (level percentile, one-year change, stretch, what followed past extremes — rebalancing, not catch-up)

spx.note: own-history percentile of RSP ÷ SPY (prior days only, from 250 readings); an entry = the first day at or under the 5th percentile after 63 sessions away

strategies.single: all the money at the trigger close
strategies.dca: five equal parts at the trigger close and every 12 sessions after
strategies.fan: the trigger tranche plus one limit at every fan line below the trigger close (each line's value that day, known at the open); equal parts
strategies.pivots: the trigger tranche plus the last three swing lows below, the rising diagonal through the last two swing lows, and its lower parallel; equal parts
strategies.rsi: the trigger tranche plus one part at the first close whose RSI own-percentile is at or under 20, 10, 5, 2, 1
strategies.all: fan + pivots + RSI (10, 5, 1) together, equal parts
strategies.state: the fan ladder, with the trigger tranche's share raised by the VIX's own percentile at the trigger (100th → half the money at once)

design.rules: a price rung fills at min(open, level) on the first day the low touches the level; a close-based rung fills at that close; whatever is unfilled after 60 sessions is bought at that close, so every strategy ends fully invested and is compared on the same money; the next campaign needs a new 252-session high first

pce.note: the Hub's economic calendar begins in June 2024, so only these releases are on file; older PCE days are not inferred

mu.note: MU reports after the close; the reaction day is the next session. Eight call dates come from the Hub's transcripts table; earlier report days are INFERRED as the highest-volume day (≥ 2× its prior month) inside each quarterly reporting window, and are marked so.
